question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Ramya is an __ardent __follower of secularism.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ardent"** means having or showing very strong feelings; passionate. (उत्साही)

 
 
• **Example: **She is an **ardent **supporter of environmental conservation.
 
 
 
• **"Committed" **refers to being dedicated or loyal to a cause, activity, or job. (समर्पित)
 
 
• **Example: **He is **committed** to improving the quality of education in his community.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'ardent' **is **'committed'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Forced **(मजबूर): Obtained or imposed by coercion or physical power.

 
 
• **Example:** He felt **forced** to take the job due to financial constraints.
 
 
 
• **Temporary **(अस्थायी ): Lasting for only a limited period of time; not permanent.
 
 
• **Example: **She took a **temporary** job for the summer.
 
 
 
• **Unhappy** (दुखी): Not happy; sad or distressed.
 
 
• **Example:** He was** unhappy **with the results of the exam.
